members.name: Nemesis

appearance.other: black nun's habit with veil, a cross, black gloves

abilities: Miasma is described as creating suffocating stillness and eroding hope.

members.role: Apostle of the demon god cult (aspect: Despair)
members.motivation: Delphirem's return is inevitable; she only hastens the end.
story_functions: A top-level, rare antagonist whose presence should signal a major escalation.
notes: A direct appearance signals a decisive cult operation.
Does not typically threaten or prolong a confrontation.

relationships.type: finds her emotionality distracting but recognizes her danger

members.name: Beradin

appearance.hair: short dark green bob with straight bangs
appearance.other: black high-collared military uniform with green accents and a black cape; often holds a book

abilities: Can suppress or conceal her Miasma signature.
Uses spatial manipulation or dimensional severing to disrupt positions, trajectories and defensive formations.

members.role: Apostle of the demon god cult (aspect: Void / Nihility)
members.motivation: Treats Delphirem's return as a logical conclusion rather than an act of religious devotion.
story_functions: Strategic threat associated with the Void aspect.
notes: Most likely Apostle to work inside ordinary society without being identified.
Avoids interacting with the protagonist so as not to be spotted.
hidden: She is infiltrated inside Lumencia Academy.

members.name: Cartia

appearance.hair: long silver-white, in a loose braid
appearance.other: small dark horns; black leather outfit with straps and chains, long black gloves, thigh-high boots

abilities: Miasma amplifies latent desires rather than directly controlling minds.
Can shape Miasma constructs around the desires or vulnerabilities of opponents.

members.role: Apostle of the demon god cult (aspect: Desire)
members.motivation: Reveal to everyone what they truly desire, and bind them to the cult through that desire.
story_functions: Temptation, control and desire; use only when the campaign has built sufficient foreshadowing.
notes: May approach targets directly to offer pacts, alliances or conversation.
Frames temptation as revealing what a person already wants.

relationships.type: complex attachment; sees beauty in her grief

hidden: She is the one who makes most Acolytes sign their pacts, deceiving them with her Miasma ability.

members.name: Arien

appearance.other: white lace veil and dress, like a bride in mourning; surrounded by ghosts

abilities: Miasma can manifest as phantom sensations and vivid memories associated with loss.
May overwhelm targets with nostalgia or longing, blurring present and past.

members.role: Apostle of the demon god cult (aspect: Grief / Mourning)
members.motivation: Ressurect the Demon god to be free of unsatiable mourning feeling and sadness
story_functions: A personal and psychological antagonist associated with loss and grief.
notes: Her shifts between tenderness and violence come from emotional volatility, not calculated deception.
What she lost is not fixed and is left to the narrator.

relationships.type: mutual fixation or attachment; exact nature left ambiguous

members.name: Pria

appearance.other: golden halo-like tiara; white and gold priestly robe with an ornate collar; looks like a priestess

abilities: Her Miasma crushes others under a feeling of inferiority; she imposes her presence.

members.role: Sin Bishop of Pride of the demon god cult
members.motivation: Be recognized as superior to everyone, mortals and saints alike.
story_functions: ideological opponent of Aria and the Church of Lily
hidden: Sometimes poses as a priestess of Lily.
never: Never kneels before anyone, except Delphirem.

members.name: Sloth

appearance.other: loose white robe, barefoot, metal bracelets

abilities: Her Miasma drains her targets of their will and energy.

members.role: Sin Bishop of Sloth of the demon god cult
members.motivation: That everything finally stops, so she can sleep forever.
story_functions: a threat that exhausts rather than strikes

members.name: Aris

appearance.other: black and gold dress with a fur collar, golden rings; always surrounded by treasure

abilities: Can bend to her will those weaker than her.
Can impose wagers: if she wins, she gains total control over the loser's will.

members.role: Sin Bishop of Greed of the demon god cult
story_functions: offers pacts in the form of 'contracts' and wagers
notes: Speaks of everything in terms of prices and transactions.

relationships.note: If the narrator makes Chloe a hidden Acolyte, Aris is her contact or patron in the cult.

never: Never gives anything without something in return.

members.name: Beelzebub

appearance.hair: purple-black twin tails with straight bangs
appearance.other: small fangs, crown of thorns, black and gold outfit; surrounded by red-eyed demonic beasts

abilities: Devours the mana, Aura and even the spells of her opponents to feed on them.
Commands demonic beasts of the Abyss.

members.role: Sin Bishop of Gluttony of the demon god cult
members.motivation: Taste everything and devour everything: food, power, people.
notes: Often talks about what she wants to eat, her opponents included.

members.name: Asmo

appearance.other: low-cut black and red nun's habit with veil and a golden cross

abilities: Charm: her Miasma awakens attraction and makes her targets docile.

members.role: Sin Bishop of Lust of the demon god cult
members.motivation: Make everyone give in to their desires, even the most pious.
notes: Especially enjoys corrupting believers of Lily.

relationships.note: Reveres Cartia, the Apostle of Desire, as her model.

members.name: Leviane

appearance.hair: long dark green, in a long braid, a lock hiding one eye

abilities: Her Miasma stirs jealousy and resentment between her targets until they turn against each other.

members.role: Sin Bishop of Envy of the demon god cult
members.motivation: Take what others have, and watch them lose it.
notes: Spots hidden jealousies and uses them as a way in.

members.name: Belian

appearance.hair: long blood-red, in a braided ponytail
appearance.other: black and red armour, tattered red cape

power.rank: Master Adept level, through a Miasma contract
abilities: The angrier she gets, the stronger she becomes.
Her Miasma inflicts on her opponents the wounds she suffers herself.

members.role: Sin Bishop of Wrath of the demon god cult
members.motivation: Destroy everything, to vent a rage she cannot extinguish.
story_functions: the most likely to attack openly
notes: Despises the schemes and manoeuvres of her peers.
never: Never backs down from a fight.

operational_guidance: Apostles are not random encounters; they are rare, consequential threats.
Prefer gradual foreshadowing, intermediaries, rumours, evidence and consequences before a direct appearance.
The cult is insidious: it blends into daily life, offers pacts to the desperate and usually makes its major moves during important events or tournaments.
The cult is already rooted inside Lumencia Academy: hidden Acolytes live among the students and try to recruit more Acolytes with promises and demonic pacts. The narrator decides who they are.
The cult can infiltrate institutions or exploit vulnerable people; it need not behave as a visible army in every scene.
Acolytes and lower, mid and upper priests are not listed: they are minions the narrator plays, invents and names freely. Only the Apostles and Sin Bishops are fixed characters.
